query:
SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rb_submission
                        WHERE team_id = $1 AND puzzle_id = $2
                            AND saction = 0
                            AND NOT ignored)
                        AS failure_count,
                    p.penalty,
                    p.id AS puzzle_id
                FROM rb_puzzle p
                WHERE p.id = $2
                GROUP BY p.id, p.penalty;
